question: IIT Bombay and ________ have partnered to develop India's first Quantum Diamond Microchip Imager.
solution:
The correct answer is __**TCS**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay (IIT-Bombay) and Tata Consultancy Services (TCS**) are partnering to develop India's first Quantum Diamond Microchip Imager
 
• The **Quantum Diamond Microchip Imager **is an advanced sensing tool that will test the quality of semiconductor chips without damaging them.
 
• The** partnership aims to transform sectors like electronics and healthcare** and to propel India forward with new technologies. 
 
• TCS **is a global leader in IT services**, consulting, and business solutions.
 
• They have been partnering with **some of the world's largest businesses for over 56 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahindra and Mahindra**

 
 
• **​Mahindra & Mahindra is an Indian automobile manufacturing company** headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• It **was established in 1945 as Mahindra & Mohammed and later renamed Mahindra & Mahindra**.
 
• Part of the Mahindra Group,** M&M is one of the largest vehicle manufacturers by production in India; the Mahindra Tractors subsidiary is the largest manufacturer of tractors in the world by volume.**
 
 
 
• **L&T** 
 
 
• **Larsen & Toubro Limited, abbreviated as L&T**, is an Indian **multinational conglomerate, with interests in industrial technology, heavy industry, engineering, construction, manufacturing, power, information technology, military and financial services.**
 
• It is **headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.**
 
• L&T **was founded in 1938 in Bombay by Danish engineers Henning Holck-Larsen and Søren Kristian Toubro**
